_comment: Demo-mode fixtures (ADR-052). Keyed by GraphQL Query field name, which comes from the spec's operationId. Deliberately NOT the seeded database rows — the point of demo mode is that a reviewer can tell mock from live at a glance, so these players are fictional and the points differ. Only Query fields are wrapped by mock-switch.js; createPlayer/createScore are mutations and always go live. Developer-owned: regeneration does not overwrite this file.
